endpoint.grammar: One signed decimal value on the first completed line, compared by exact decimal value. In comparison tasks a valid number outside the displayed pair is an endpoint violation.
endpoint.completion: Observed newline or EOS within the generation budget
endpoint.decoding: Unrestricted greedy decoding with one beam

probe_design.gradient_unit: Average eligible replay-qualified presentation gradients within each comparison. Each comparison contributes one raw corrective-margin gradient; never duplicate comparisons or normalize item gradients.
probe_design.right_factor: Reuse exact source-hash-bound Phase III-M selected columns and fixed unit right factor. No supervision-dependent geometry discovery.
probe_design.fit_selection: Require at least two replay-qualified incorrect valid presentations spanning both frozen wordings per comparison. Parent-correct presentations and comparisons remain preservation obligations. Deterministic replay-fork-count-descending then frozen-ID selection: A eight comparisons from eight families, two per close/far and shorter/longer group. B/C same eight comparisons from four families, two close and two far, both opposing comparisons eligible. A family diversity differs from B/C and is an explicit causal limitation. Missing any required quota gives HOLD, never relabel a correct comparison.
probe_design.preservation: One shared prospective anchor set covers four groups and both wordings. Rank by maximum adverse BF16 secant across A/B/C preliminary directions. Replay-qualify at most three rounds. All correct adaptation and preservation-fit responses remain protected in full generation, with inherited128trajectorycap; exceeding cap HOLD.
probe_design.uncertainty: For each arm and target norm independently, solve and match at allowance zero, measure adverse calibration residuals on the actual rounded proposal against its projected delta prediction, raise allowance only for this cell, then resolve/match and independently remeasure. At most two calibration passes per cell. Final adverse quantile must not exceed used allowance, otherwise UNCERTIFIED HOLD cell. No cross-direction universal allowance.
probe_design.measured_slack: Every active sampled stored-precision decision must preserve the original greedy token and exceed the positive calibration floor. The hard complete-generation guard covers all authorized correct responses.
probe_design.norm_matching: Bounded deterministic numerical search over constrained proposals. Every trial inspects actual rounded BF16 support, norm, hash, authorization and linearized constraints. No norm above .025. Retain closest admissible proposal. MATCHED only if relative norm error <=.02 or absolute <=1e-8, otherwise UNMATCHED and exclude from matched causal contrasts. Report all stored deltas and pairwise cosines. At every adjustment remeasure all eight active native prefix margins, requiring strict excess above the positive floor and exact parent restoration. At most two norm searches per cell. Record all logit forwards and active constraints.
probe_design.practice_gate: Positive strict comparison gain, at least one repeatable error corrected across both orders and wordings, zero previously correct or validity losses on adaptation and preservation-fit, valid rate >=.9, positive measured anchor slack, authorized BF16 norm/support.
probe_design.development_transfer_gate: Independently reload each distinct practice passer. Require positive strict comparison gain, zero prohibited regressions or validity losses, valid rate >=.9, and at least one newly complete truth-flipping family (eight correct presentations). Never refit using this partition.
probe_design.finalist_ranking: After development transfer lock one survivor by complete family gain, strict comparison gain, smallest realized norm, then lexical arm ID. Only this locked finalist may reach preservation validation or independent selection.
probe_design.data_boundary: Fitting receives only adaptation, preservation-fit and calibration. Development transfer is post-fit. Preservation validation and selection are inaccessible until the appropriate lock passes. Hidden is host-held. No outcome may become fitting data in this study.
probe_design.geometry: Primary inherited layer23, exact audited M columns and fixed right, rank one. No second layer/rank, no within-family supplemental arm in this CPU trial.
probe_design.deduplication: Exact rounded tensor identity shares one behavioral observation. Six unique full candidate practice probes maximum across A/B/C by two norms.

pair_solver.objective: maximize the minimum absolute predicted per-comparison corrective margin, using one averaged replay fork margin and sensitivity per comparison
pair_solver.failure: HOLD the cell when no bounded numerical witness is found; no claim of global infeasibility

probe_design.pair_diagnostics: Record pairwise projected corrective-gradient cosine, norms and ratio for the four selected paired families and any other union family for which both comparison gradients were collected. Record other eligible families as gradient-unmeasured; do not expand the16comparison gradient budget. Positive/negative cosine is only local evidence, not global compatibility or a reasoning-circuit identification.
probe_design.budget_reduction: No automatic extension, no supplemental within-family direction, no rank/layer change. Stop/HOLD on runtime limits before generating further candidates.

candidate_lock: No automatic lineage acceptance. Post-fit development transfer locks one finalist. Require separate preservation and selection gates before host-held hidden verification. A successful hidden result remains a research candidate requiring operator review.
study_question: Paired versus one-sided supervision allocation with eight comparisons per arm; B versus C separately tests pair-aware objective on identical paired data.
receipt_compatibility: Reuse trusted Phase III-M independent-verifier worker, assessment and outcome wire formats. N typed fit and stage locks bind the N protocol, sources and roster. Wire version is not study identity.
